findings.evidence: Kinematics.lean:131-135 (fields, untagged) vs :234, :250, :267, :280 (`@[simp]` on the derived identities). In-repo precedent for the identical pattern: `EpsilonEridani/Mathematics/LinearAlgebra/BilinearForm/LightConeBasis.lean:95` `attribute [simp] nPlus_nPlus_eq_zero nMinus_nMinus_eq_zero nPlus_nMinus_eq_one nMinus_nPlus_eq_one` on the same kind of bilinear-form structure fields.
findings.fix: Add `attribute [simp] minkowskiProduct_p_self minkowskiProduct_pPrime_self minkowskiProduct_n_self` at the top of `namespace OffForwardKinematics`.
findings.issue: The three equational fields `minkowskiProduct_p_self`, `minkowskiProduct_pPrime_self`, `minkowskiProduct_n_self` are not `@[simp]`, while every derived Minkowski product in the file is (`minkowskiProduct_avgMomentum_self_eq`, `minkowskiProduct_n_deltaOrthN_eq_zero`, ...). The simp set therefore normalizes `⟪K.avgMomentum, K.avgMomentum⟫ₘ` but leaves `⟪K.p, K.p⟫ₘ` and `⟪K.n, K.n⟫ₘ` untouched.

findings.evidence: Grep of the file shows the only lemmas mentioning `K.p`/`K.pPrime` in a product are `minkowskiProduct_n_p_eq` (:205) and `minkowskiProduct_n_pPrime_eq` (:213); no `⟪K.p, K.pPrime⟫ₘ` anywhere. From `tMom_def` and `minkowskiProduct_sub_self`, `t = 2M² - 2⟪p, p'⟫ₘ`. The roadmap target asks for "the identities among `p`, `p'`, `P`, `Δ`, `t`, `ξ`" (roadmap README §0.1, lines 324-327).
findings.fix: Add the on-shell identities, e.g. `minkowskiProduct_p_pPrime_eq : ⟪K.p, K.pPrime⟫ₘ = M ^ 2 - K.tMom / 2`, `minkowskiProduct_p_delta_eq : ⟪K.p, K.delta⟫ₘ = -K.tMom / 2`, `minkowskiProduct_pPrime_delta_eq : ⟪K.pPrime, K.delta⟫ₘ = K.tMom / 2` (plus the swapped orders, as the file already does for `delta`/`avgMomentum`), tagged `@[simp]` like their siblings.
findings.issue: `tMom` is characterized only through `delta`; the file proves every pairing among `n`, `avgMomentum`, `delta`, `deltaOrthN` but none involving the carrier's own momenta `p`, `pPrime`. A consumer holding `p` and `p'` (what the Layer 0.2+ correlators hold) cannot get `t` without re-deriving via `delta_def` and `minkowskiProduct_sub_self`.

findings.evidence: Kinematics.lean:76-82 provide `tZero_zero_right`/`tZero_neg_right` only; `tZero` (:72) depends on `M` only through `M ^ 2`, and the structure (:131) imposes no sign condition on `M`.
findings.fix: Add the parallel left-argument lemmas `@[simp] tZero_neg_left (M ξ : ℝ) : tZero (-M) ξ = tZero M ξ` and `@[simp] tZero_zero_left (ξ : ℝ) : tZero 0 ξ = 0` (the massless case, where the bound degenerates to `t ≤ 0`).
findings.issue: `tZero`'s skewness argument gets both `tZero_zero_right` and `tZero_neg_right`, but its mass argument gets neither, even though `OffForwardKinematics` constrains only `M ^ 2` (`⟪p, p⟫ₘ = M ^ 2`), so `M`'s sign is free and `K : OffForwardKinematics d (-M)` is indistinguishable from `OffForwardKinematics d M` with no lemma to bridge the two bounds.

summary: Exposure, `_def` coverage, and extensionality are correct, but the characteristic API is incomplete: the structure's defining product fields carry no `@[simp]` although every derived product identity does, no identity relates `p`/`pPrime` to `t`, and `tZero`'s `M` argument has none of the parallel lemmas its `ξ` argument has.
